Olivia (People Ops): Heads-up — all-hands stream starting in 5. I see recording set to 'on' but the stream preview shows red. Can someone from infra confirm? 
Raj (Eng): I can check the stream instance. seeing `rtmp` connected but encoder is throwing 503s. 
Ken (Infra): digging in — looks like the transcoder restarted 1m ago. I'm tailing logs. 
Aisha (Eng+SRE): @Ken can we flip to backup region? We should avoid cutting the Q&A. 
Ken (Infra): backup region is warm, will failover if I don't get encoder up in 30s. 
Olivia (People Ops): If we failover, any change to join link? I posted the meeting link in calendar. 
Ken (Infra): no link change, same CDN entrypoint. 
Priya (Product): Also, agenda tweak — can we move "Roadmap highlights" after Q&A? Speakers want to shorten exec updates. 
Olivia (People Ops): we can — will announce 2-min heads-up before changes. 
Raj (Eng): encoder is back, stream green. I'm seeing the live preview in GCS: `https://stream.redwood.dev/live/1745312468/preview` 
Olivia (People Ops): Nice — @infra-bot please confirm recording destination. 
infra-bot: Recording job 74b3 started -> saved to `s3://redwood-recordings/all-hands/2026-03-23-1745312468.mp4`. 
Aisha (Eng+SRE): Quick note — we got a user report of echo for remote participants. Can we mute mic for presenters to reduce loop? 
Diane (CEO): I'm on Webex + laptop; can someone give me a quick checklist for avoiding echo? 
Ken (Infra): Diane — use headset, mute laptop speakers, or use browser-only and plug headset. If echo persists I'll open an adhoc channel. 
Priya (Product): For Q&A — we'll keep the meeting open for anonymous questions in Slido; link is in #all-hands thread. 
Olivia (People Ops): Thanks everyone. If anything else happens ping me directly — I'll post a recording link after upload. :thumbsup: 
Raj (Eng): follow-up: encoder error logs snippet: ```
[2026-03-23T15:14:02Z] ERROR: ffmpeg: connection reset by peer
[2026-03-23T15:14:03Z] INFO: transcoder restarted
``` 
Aisha (Eng+SRE): we'll retro this in postmortems if it reoccurs. 
Olivia (People Ops): Recorded session will be available in ~10-15min. Posting here when done. 
Ken (Infra): Confirmed: no failover used, single short hiccup only. 
Diane (CEO): Thanks team. Q for leadership during Q&A: will the Dedicated roadmap include more instance sizing options? (I'll ask live) 
Olivia (People Ops): Noted — Priya/Diane to handle that in live Q&A. 
Priya (Product): I'll take it. Also reminding presenters to keep slides to 5 mins max. 
Olivia (People Ops): End.
